title: Pune Metro Line 3: 78% work done, says PMRDA - Times of India
text: PMRDA said Pune Metro Line 3 from Hinjewadi to Shivajinagar is now 78 per cent complete. Trial runs are planned for December 2026 on the 23.3 km corridor.

expect.note: 2026-09-30 off-topic (Hinjewadi is not our corridor); from 2026-11-15 kept: Metro Line 3 has its own tracker page (/news/track/pune-metro-line-3), so its news is ours
